trainer/30527.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Hello! I'm Blacksmith Silvera. Keeping yourself warm in this cold weather? Ha ha! I'm very busy myself these days dealing with so many test candidates for Artisan. Perhaps are you also an applicant? Or are you here to learn skills? Something else?

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

trainer/30527-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Hunh! I teach Dwarven Fighters and Artisans. Can you understand that? If you can, then begone. On a busy day like this ... bloody annoying!

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30527-01.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Is that so? Well, keep searching. I know you will find it!

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30527-02.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Ha! The Calculator? Why are you bothering me for it? Certainly you can find another Dwarf to get one from! Okay. You win. Actually, I'm tired of carrying it around. I hoped to exchange it for something more useful or pretty, but in this village, nobody has anything I find intere…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30527-04.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Have you brought me the 10 crystals from Gemstone Beasts ? If you want the Calculator you must bring me the crystals immediately! The beasts can be found in the Abandoned Mine . Please hurry!

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30527-03.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Oh, they are more beautiful than I imagined! You have made me very happy! Here is your Calculator.

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30527-05.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: I already gave you the Calculator! Don't you remember?

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-01.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: I teach young Dwarves and manage the Test of the Artisan. All apprentice Dwarves arrive at an important turning point where they must decide their future occupations. Dwarves may choose the path of the Artisan or the Scavenger. Artisans, who I'm responsible for testing, create s…

links.text: Say you want to be an Artisan.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-07.html.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Ok, if you've brought your homework, let me take a look! One, two, three ... There's not enough! You don't want to fail your first test do you? I told you clearly! Ten boogle ratman front teeth, and two from the boogle ratman leaders! If you understand that, go and find them! Hu…

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-02.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: But one moment! You wish to be an Artisan? You must be mistaken. You cannot become an Artisan! Impossible! Go walk your own path. I do not have time to spare for dealing with those who are not qualified.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-02a.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: You! You must be mistaken. You are already an Artisan! Are you joking?!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-03.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: Sorry! You are not yet qualified to be an Artisan. I warn you: it is not an easy path. To even take the test, you must first meet certain minimum qualifications. Gain more experience. Then return to me after you have reached at least level 18.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-04.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: What are you doing, loitering around here when you've already taken the test? Go on and change profession to an Artisan!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-05.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvery: Oh, fine, fine! I see that you are ready for the Artisan test. It is administered by the guild master of the Black Anvil, of whom you have certainly heard - a blacksmith of great renown! I will give the first, most basic of the tests; if you pass, you may go on to the second tes…

links.text: Take the first part of the test.

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-06.htm.text: Blacksmith Silvera: The first test is very easy; Though the Artisan's main task is making things, to be sure, he must also be able to find the materials needed for manufacture by himself, and not depend on others. The first test puts its focus on those basic skills. Oh, and by the way, take this ri…

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-08b.html.text: Blacksmith Silvery: Very well, then! Seek Blacksmith Kluto in Gludin Village . From him you will receive the second of the tests. Good fortune to you!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30527-08c.html.text: Blacksmith Silvery: Let it be so! Seek out Railroad Worker Obi on the Plains of Plunder . He shall instruct you in what to do next. Good luck, candidate!

They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
